details: Global markets exhibited mixed trading as investors assessed renewed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, alongside reports of de-escalation. The US and Iran have reportedly agreed to halt mutual attacks and resume talks, with discussions concerning the Strait of Hormuz expected to take place in Qatar. This development follows a period of heightened exchanges and aims to prevent further supply disruptions. Easing tensions are seen as a positive for risk assets, but investor sentiment remains cautious due to the fragile nature of the peace efforts.
title: US-Iran Tensions Cool, Talks Set for Strait of Hormuz

details: Europe's Markets in Crypto Assets (MiCA) framework is transitioning from its transitional period to full enforcement on July 1, 2026. This marks a significant regulatory shift for crypto companies operating within the EU's 27 member states, requiring them to obtain formal licenses. The move introduces regulatory clarity for licensed operators but could lead to "user migration friction" and affect European trading volumes and sentiment as unlicensed firms face potential suspension or fines.
title: EU MiCA Regulation Fully Enforced, Impacting Crypto Exchanges

details: The US House Speaker Mike Johnson announced that a housing bill, which includes a temporary ban on central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) until 2030, is slated to be sent to President Trump for signing. This legislation aims to prevent the development of a US CBDC, which could significantly impact the competitive landscape for decentralized cryptocurrencies.
title: US House Passes CBDC Ban, Sent to Trump

details: Polymarket, a prediction market platform, has experienced a substantial surge in 24-hour trading volume, reaching $23.3 million. This increase is primarily driven by user engagement in markets related to geopolitical events, such as potential diplomatic or military actions involving Iran, and speculation on cryptocurrency prices, including Bitcoin and upcoming Federal Reserve decisions. This highlights the growing trend of using prediction markets to gauge and speculate on a wide array of future outcomes.
title: Geopolitical Events Fuel Polymarket Trading Volume

details: The White House is reportedly engaging with law enforcement organizations to address their objections to new cryptocurrency legislation, specifically the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. This initiative aims to refine the bill's provisions, particularly a section intended to protect decentralized finance (DeFi) developers by clarifying that software developers, who do not control the tools they enable, are not considered "money transmitters." The discussions seek to balance innovation with concerns about illicit finance.
title: White House Consults Law Enforcement on Crypto Clarity Act
